note: Corps of Engineers campground below Clearwater Dam, on both banks of the Black River's wide tailwater pool: three paved loops on a lawn under big scattered trees on the north bank, with the boat ramp, shelters and playground, and a small wooded loop on the south bank reached separately. A few sites at the east end of loop A and the south-bank loop are closest to the water. One wheeled unit per site. Trailhead of the Black River hike and bike trail. --Claude
summary: Open year-round (recreation.gov notice); reservations March 15 to October 30, first come first served in between - so nothing is bookable today but the park is open. 103 public sites (none stored): 80 at 30A, 23 at 50A with water, 3 without hookups; $14-20 (stored $14-16). No sewer at any site in the catalog - stored sewer true cleared. Riverview stands. Pin is on the campground. Phone found.
flags: SEWER CLEARED: stored hookups.sewer true (source 'note prose; recreation.gov campsite catalog'). The current catalog has no Sewer Hookup attribute on any of the 110 records, the facility text says 'The majority of campsites have electric and water hookups. Additional amenities include a dump station', and the amenity list has Electric Hookups and Water Hookups but no sewer. A missing attribute is not a no, so I wrote null (unknown) rather than false; the dump station is in facilities.

WHICH SITES HAVE WHAT: 50A + water on 23 sites (A34-A46 range, C12-C21, GA2) at $20; 30A + water on B01-B07 at $20; 30A only on the other 73 electric sites at $16 (the facility text's 'majority ... electric and water' overstates the catalog's 30 water sites); R04, R05 and R13 have no hookups, $14; A46 is the $40 site (120 ft, on the double template). The $17 template was not on any of the seven sites I opened.

RIVER VIEW (stored riverview, approved 2026-10-21 - stands; only the river counts, the lake is behind the dam): per-site coordinates on leaf-off imagery. North bank: sites A38, A39, A40, A41 at the east end of loop A are about 25-40 m from the pool's edge across an open sandy bank with a few trees and no road between; A36, A37, A42, A43 about 45-60 m. Sites C01-C08 face the river about 40-50 m away, but the boat-ramp approach and parking lie between. Loops B and the rest of A are 80-200 m back on the lawn. South bank (loop R, 9 sites): R04 and R05 (both no-hookup) are about 20-30 m from the water under thin hardwoods, R03 about 35 m, R01 about 25 m from a backwater behind a gravel spit with the loop road between. So perhaps six sites are within 40 m with nothing between - too few of 103 to call the campground riverfront; riverview fits.
PIN: stored 37.1336,-90.7669 (recreation.gov's point) falls between loops A and B on the north-bank lawn, on the campground. No move.

SOUTH-BANK LOOP: loop R is across the river from the main campground, about 250 m south of it, with its own road in from the south side; it is 9 sites and not a separate campground on recreation.gov. No split proposed.
SITE COUNT: none stored; written 103 from the catalog (Open standard sites).
